invariants.rationale: The method only returns either -1 or a non-negative index.
Return value is -1 when no button is checked, else it's a valid index (>= 0).
If a valid index is returned, it must be within the bounds of the buttons list.
If an index is found, there must be at least one checked button.
If there are checked buttons, result is the index of the first checked one.
